items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for the second straight day after exiting Week 4 early; viewed as week-to-week and unlikely for Week 5 vs JAX.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-hamstring tweak; Rapoport week-to-week context.
items.implication: Will Shipley elevated to lead back vs JAX with Bigsby on IR.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries for Shipley; reverse prior Bigsby handcuff value.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury; Friday practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL.
items.implication: If OUT, major QB downgrade and Ravens offense impact; Flowers/Henry/Likely/Andrews affected.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. re-injured foot (plantar fasciitis); expected to miss multiple weeks per HC Mike McCarthy.
items.opportunity: Sustained target share increase for Pitt WR room.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: Will Shipley expected to lead PHI backfield vs JAX with Barkley/Bigsby OUT/IR; 'Will Shipley show'.
items.why: Barkley week-to-week/OUT likely, Bigsby IR; Shipley primary.
items.implication: Shipley as low-end RB2/3 or better in PPR with volume.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, goal-line for Shipley; Dameon Pierce handcuff.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Status watch for Week 5; Keon Coleman/others potential beneficiaries.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) did not practice Thursday again after re-aggravation.
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk vs DEN; Johnston/others target bump if sits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and depth.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday again alongside Barkley.
items.implication: Depleted PHI pass catchers; Hurts/Goedert/Wicks elevated usage.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft pass D.
Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + soft RB D, boosted by CIN WR injuries.
Bears RB D'Andre Swift limited (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight day (thumb/toe).
items.implication: Swift still lead but monitor; Monangai stash risk.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume/RZ vs weak receiver D.
Berry loves Isaiah Likely @ WSH as TE5; positional/coverage weakness.
Berry hates Mark Andrews @ ATL as TE17; thin role/tough matchup/usage numbers.
Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs.
items.why: xFP data shows efficiency variance; sortable for subscribers.
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch; favor overperformers if opportunities hold, fade under if volume dips.
items.opportunity: Role/efficiency edge for Bijan/Kyren; monitor Jeanty/Chase Brown volume.
